title: mimo
intro: MiMo Code, an OpenCode-style CLI, headless over `mimo run --format json`, on an Anthropic-shaped provider through `MIMOCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT`.
notes: `-c` continues the last session in this directory.
The `MIMOCODE_*` switches stop the model fetch, autoupdate and analytics.
Its first start migrates a local database, which can take a while; later turns are quick.
